newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-SLOVENIA SCORES SURPRISE 2-0 WIN OVER AUSTRIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVENIA SCORES SURPRISE 2-0 WIN OVER AUSTRIA.

text.p: Austria's build-up to their important World Cup qualifying match against Scotland next month suffered a blow on Tuesday when they slumped to a surprise 2-0 defeat in a friendly against Slovenia.
Forwards Primoz Gliha and Ermin Siljak both profited from a weak defence to score in the 73rd and 82nd minutes respectively and condemn the Austrians to their first defeat since November 1995.
The win, however, was a major boost for Slovenia who also face a World Cup qualifying match against Croatia in Split in a fortnight.
